This maize plot is small but it is the one that feeds my family, so I must treat it well. I am hoping to get a FISP coupon this year like many of my neighbours — if I do, I will buy NPK 23-21-0+4S for basal and urea for top dressing, because without the subsidy the price is too high for me. I will also carry manure from my goats and chickens to help the soil, since fertilizer alone is not enough on these tired lands. I will plant hybrid seed from the agro-dealer in Ntchisi boma because the local seed does not yield well with fertilizer, but I will not spray pesticide — fall armyworm I handle by going into the field and putting sand or ash in the funnels myself. The rains here in Ntchisi are usually good from November to April so I will not irrigate; this plot is rainfed like all my land.
